output_text:
import os
import google.cloud.speech_v1 as speech

def partial_results(payload, config=None):
    config = config or {}
    client = speech.SpeechClient()
    recognition_config = speech.RecognitionConfig(
        language_code=config.get("language_code", "en-US"),
        enable_automatic_punctuation=config.get("punctuation", True),
    )
    streaming_config = speech.StreamingRecognitionConfig(
        config=recognition_config,
        interim_results=True
    )
    def request_gen():
        yield speech.StreamingRecognizeRequest(streaming_config=streaming_config)
        yield speech.StreamingRecognizeRequest(audio_content=payload)
        yield speech.StreamingRecognizeRequest(audio_content=b"")
    responses = client.streaming_recognize(streaming_config=streaming_config, requests=request_gen())
    result = [
        {
            "transcript": r.alternatives[0].transcript,
            "confidence": r.alternatives[0].confidence,
            "is_final": r.is_final
        }
        for response in responses
        for r in response.results
        if r.alternatives
    ]
    return result
